validation.invalid_currency: Invalid currency; use a three-letter ISO 4217 code
validation.min_price_above_price: The minimum price cannot be above the sale price
validation.categories_required: At least one category is required
validation.variants_required: At least one variant is required
validation.variant_default_required: Exactly one variant must be marked as the default
validation.variant_sku_duplicate: Two variants cannot share the same SKU
validation.attribute_value_required: An attribute must carry exactly one value
validation.availability_end_before_start: The window must end after it starts
validation.availability_hours_paired: Set both hours or neither - no hours at all means the whole day
validation.availability_day_duplicate: Only one interval per day - this day already has one
validation.availability_every_day_exclusive: An every-day interval must be the only one
validation.invalid_option: An option group must offer at least one answer
validation.option_max_below_min: The maximum number of choices cannot be below the minimum
validation.option_min_above_options: The group asks for more choices than it offers
validation.option_default_duplicate: Only one answer per group can be preselected
validation.bundle_group_too_few: The choice "{{group}}" needs two candidates - with one there is nothing to choose between
validation.bundle_optional_in_group: A component inside a choice group is chosen through the group, not on its own
validation.bundle_default_not_chosen: Only a component the customer chooses can be preselected
validation.bundle_delta_not_chosen: Only a component the customer chooses can carry a price adjustment
validation.bundle_composition_too_small: A bundle needs one component with a quantity of 2, or two different components that are always included
validation.available_until_before_from: The availability end date must be after the start date
validation.invalid_unit_for_type: A {{type}} product cannot be sold per {{unit}}
validation.type_value_type_mismatch: This capture type cannot store this kind of value
validation.unit_requires_number: A measurement unit only applies to a numeric attribute
validation.unit_excludes_suffix: An attribute carries either a unit or a suffix, not both
validation.bounds_require_number: Value bounds only apply to a numeric attribute
validation.max_below_min: The maximum value cannot be below the minimum
validation.options_require_term: Only a term-backed attribute can offer a list of values
validation.options_required: A term-backed attribute needs at least one admissible value

error.slug_already_exists: Another product already uses this slug for the same language
error.variant_sku_already_exists: Another variant already uses this SKU
error.barcode_already_exists: Another variant already uses this barcode
error.attribute_already_defined: This category already declares this attribute
error.attribute_not_declared: This attribute is not declared for the product's categories
error.attribute_required: The attribute "{{attribute}}" is required for this product's categories
error.attribute_scope_conflict: "{{attribute}}" is declared by {{first}} as a {{first_scope}} attribute and by {{second}} as a {{second_scope}} attribute. A product cannot sit in both - remove one of the categories, or make the two declarations agree.
error.attribute_value_type_mismatch: The value does not match the type the attribute is declared with
error.attribute_value_not_admissible: The value is not one this attribute admits
error.attribute_value_out_of_range: The value falls outside the range this attribute admits
error.bundle_self_reference: A bundle cannot contain one of its own variants
error.bundle_nested: A bundle cannot contain another bundle
error.bundle_group_unknown: A component names a choice group the bundle does not have
